# awscc_ssm_cloud_connector (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::SSM::CloudConnector. Enables AWS Systems Manager to manage resources in external cloud providers.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config_connector_arn` (String) The ARN of the AWS Config connector.
- `configuration` (Attributes) The configuration for the cloud connector. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--configuration))
- `display_name` (String) The display name of the cloud connector.
- `role_arn` (String) The IAM role ARN used by the cloud connector.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the cloud connector.
- `tags` (Attributes List) Tags to apply to the cloud connector. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `cloud_connector_arn` (String) The ARN of the cloud connector.
- `cloud_connector_id` (String) The unique identifier of the cloud connector.
- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the cloud connector was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp when the cloud connector was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `configuration`

Required:

- `azure_configuration` (Attributes) Configuration for connecting to Azure. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--configuration--azure_configuration))

<a id="nestedatt--configuration--azure_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `configuration.azure_configuration`

Required:

- `application_id` (String) The Azure AD application ID.
- `tenant_id` (String) The Azure AD tenant ID. Cannot be changed after creation.

Optional:

- `application_display_name` (String) The display name of the Azure AD application.
- `targets` (Attributes) The targets for the cloud connector. If omitted, the entire tenant is targeted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--configuration--azure_configuration--targets))
- `tenant_display_name` (String) The display name of the Azure AD tenant.

<a id="nestedatt--configuration--azure_configuration--targets"></a>

Optional:

- `subscriptions` (Attributes List) List of Azure subscriptions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--configuration--azure_configuration--targets--subscriptions))

- `id` (String) The Azure subscription ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_ssm_cloud_connector.example
  identity = {
    cloud_connector_arn = "cloud_connector_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `cloud_connector_arn` (String) The ARN of the cloud connector

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_ssm_cloud_connector.example
  id = "cloud_connector_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_ssm_cloud_connector.example "cloud_connector_arn"
```
